question:
Study the given table and answer the question that follows.

The table shows the number of voters at three different centres A, B, C.

 
 

 
 
**Centre**

 
 
 
**Total number of registered voters**

 
 
 
**Percentage of people who voted (Out of the total number of registered voters)**

 
 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 
4600

 
 
 
78

 
 
 

 
 
B

 
 
 
5400

 
 
 
70

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 
6500

 
 
 
85

 
 
 

Number of people who did not vote at centre B is what percentage more than those who did not vote at centre C ?
solution:
**Given:**

Registered voters at Centre B = 5400

Percentage of people who voted at Centre B = 70%

Registered voters at Centre C = 6500

Percentage of people who voted at Centre C = 85%

**Formula used:**

People who did not vote = Total registered voters - People who voted

Percentage more = ((Difference in people who did not vote) / People who did not vote at Centre C) × 100

**Calculation:**

People who voted at Centre B = 5400 × 70% = 3780

People who did not vote at Centre B = 5400 - 3780

⇒ People who did not vote at Centre B = 1620

People who voted at Centre C = 6500 × 85% = 5525

People who did not vote at Centre C = 6500 - 5525

⇒ People who did not vote at Centre C = 975

Difference in people who did not vote = 1620 - 975 = 645

Percentage more = (645 / 975) × 100

⇒ Percentage more = 66 ²/₁₃ %.

**∴ The number of people who did not vote at Centre B is ****66 ****2/13 **** more than those who did not vote at Centre C.**
